subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit + launch discount for Larkhill (LH-391)
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@larkhill.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Larkhill Procurement <procurement@larkhill.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit + launch discount for Larkhill (LH-391)

Hi Irene / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Larkhill's engineering and GTM teams are aligned on a short pilot to validate integrated document ingestion and question-answering for our Support knowledge base. To get the pilot over the line with our procurement and tie it to our Q3 launch, procurement is asking for a one-time onboarding credit and a short launch discount to offset initial usage during the integration period.

Ask:
- One-time free credits: $30,000 applied to the first 60 days of usage
- Launch discount: 25% off pricing for months 1–3 post-production

Rationale:
- We expect to scale to 70k queries/month by month 6 (projected ARR uplift estimated in attached SOW).
- Fast approval enables the team to begin integration in early May and present results at our partner launch on June 18.

Attached: Larkhill_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF) — short SOW and estimated usage table.

Procurement has asked for written confirmation of any one-time credits and discount terms for their purchase order. Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve this as a one-time exception? If not, please advise the review path and timeline — procurement needs a signed SOW/PO by 30 Apr to hit the launch calendar.

Appreciate it —
Ethan Cole
Head of Product, Larkhill Systems
ethan.cole@larkhill.io
+1 415-555-0182

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@larkhill.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit + launch discount for Larkhill (LH-391)

Ethan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. We're excited by the scope and the potential ramp. I wanted to loop in Aditya (revenue lead) and flag this for an executive exception review given the size of the one-time credit.

Quick notes / questions from my side:
- Procurement deadline: you mentioned needing a signed SOW/PO by 30 Apr. We should be able to move fast if we have approval this week.
- Can you confirm whether the $30k is a credit applied to usage (token credits) or a services credit? Prefer token credits but fine either way if Procurement needs PO language.
- Would Larkhill accept a reduced credit + a 90-day launch window (we typically restrict one-time credits to a 30–90 day activation window)?

Marissa — can you prepare a one-pager summarizing ARR/expansion upside, win probability, and recommended exception amount for Aditya and Jonas? Aditya — looping you for exec approval channel and any guardrails you want to add. Jonas — finance should be able to confirm how credits are applied on the backend and any accounting notes; tagging him when we have a recommended number.

If helpful I can pull usage projections from the SOW into the one-pager.

Thanks —
Irene
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: One-time onboarding credit + launch discount for Larkhill (LH-391) — approval summary attached

Aditya / Jonas —

Forwarding Larkhill's request. Short summary below and attached a recommended approval package (LH391-approval-summary.xlsx).

Why we should approve:
- Strategic: Larkhill is a data-platform company with good partner visibility; this pilot could turn into a multi-region rollout.
- Upside: Forecasted expansion of $180k ARR within 12 months (modest confidence).
- Timing: Procurement requires a signed SOW by 30 Apr to hit their June launch window.

Recommended exception (my call):
- One-time token credits: $20,000 applied over first 90 days (reduces vendor risk and aligns with expected ramp)
- Launch discount: 20% for months 1–3
- Conditional: credits void if production not started within 90 days of SOW signature

Attachments: LH391-approval-summary.xlsx (Excel) — includes ARR projection, win probability (60%), and proposed approval language for PO.

If we agree, please advise final numbers. Jonas, if Finance signs off on the credit mechanics I will prepare updated SOW and DocuSign.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit + launch discount for Larkhill (LH-391)

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks for the quick package and the context. I discussed with Finance and the RevOps team. Given the strategic upside but wanting to protect unit economics, I approve a one-time exception with the following guardrails:

Approved terms (one-time exec exception):
- One-time token credits: $20,000 applied to usage, redeemable within 90 days of SOW signature
- Launch discount: 20% for months 1–3 post-production
- Credit clawback: credits will not be applied retroactively to usage before production start; if Larkhill does not start production within 90 days the credit will expire
- Legal: updated SOW with exception language required; no modifications to standard data handling terms

Next steps:
1) Marissa — please update the SOW and generate a DocuSign link with the approved numbers and conditional language.
2) Jonas — confirm accounting treatment and confirm how the $20k will appear on the invoice ledger (credit memo vs. contra-revenue).
3) Irene — please send confirmation to Ethan and copy procurement so they can proceed with their PO.

I appreciate the quick turn here. We should treat this as a targeted pilot exception and document the rationale in the deal record (HubSpot deal LH-391).

Best —
Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0129
